summary: This mishnah tells how the lamb of the korban tamid was tied, held and shechted, and where its blood was put on the mizbe'ach.
stIntro: In preparing the lamb of the daily offering for sacrifice, the priests

chunks.en: They did not tie the lamb's legs all together,
chunks.st: would not tie the lamb by fastening all four of its legs together;

chunks.en: rather, they tied it (each back leg to its front leg).
chunks.st: rather, they would bind it
chunks.stMore: by fastening each hind leg to the corresponding foreleg.

chunks.en: Those who won the parts
chunks.st: The priests who won the right to take the limbs up to the ramp would

chunks.en: hold on to it.
chunks.st: hold
chunks.stMore: the lamb in place while it was being slaughtered.

chunks.en: And this is how it was tied:
chunks.st: And this was the manner of its binding:
chunks.stMore: The animal would be stood in the northern part of the courtyard while

chunks.en: its head to the south, and its face to the west.
chunks.st: its head would be directed to the south, toward the altar, and its face would be turned to the west, toward the Sanctuary.

chunks.en: The shochet stands on the east side, and his face is to the west.
chunks.st: And the slaughterer would stand to the east of the animal, and his face would be to the west.
chunks.stMore: Twenty-four rings were affixed to the courtyard floor north of the altar, designated for placement of the animal’s neck during its slaughter.

chunks.en: The (tamid) of the morning was shechted
chunks.st: The daily offering of the morning was slaughtered

chunks.en: at the northwest corner (of the mizbe'ach),
chunks.st: at the northwest corner of the altar,

chunks.en: at the second ring.
chunks.explain: There were rings in the floor to hold the animal's neck.
chunks.st: at the second ring.

chunks.en: The (tamid) of the afternoon was shechted
chunks.st: The daily offering of the afternoon was slaughtered

chunks.en: at the northeast corner,
chunks.st: at the northeast corner of the altar,

chunks.en: at the second ring.
chunks.st: at the second ring.

chunks.en: The shochet shechted,
chunks.st: After the slaughterer has slaughtered the lamb

chunks.en: and the one catching (the blood) caught it in a vessel.
chunks.st: and the receiver has received
chunks.stMore: its blood in a vessel to sprinkle on the altar,

chunks.en: He comes to the northeast corner (of the mizbe'ach),
chunks.st: the priest comes to the northeast corner of the altar

chunks.en: and puts (the blood) toward the east and the north.
chunks.st: and places the first sprinkling in such a manner that the blood will reach the eastern and northern sides of the altar.

chunks.en: (Then to the) southwest corner,
chunks.st: Next, the priest comes to the southwest corner of the altar

chunks.en: and he puts (the blood) toward the west and the south.
chunks.st: and places a second sprinkling in a manner such that the blood will reach the western and southern sides of the altar.

chunks.en: The rest of the blood he would pour
chunks.st: With regard to the remainder of the blood, the priest would pour it

chunks.en: on the south part of the yesod (base).
chunks.st: at the southern base of the altar, at its southwest corner.

words.note: The yesod, the bottom part of the mizbe'ach.

summary: The Kohen hung the korban and took off its skin. Then he cut it into parts in a special order and gave each part to the Kohen who had won it. The insides were washed well.
stIntro: When the priest flayed the hide of the daily offering after its slaughter,

chunks.he: לֹא הָיָה שׁוֹבֵר בּוֹ אֶת הָרֶגֶל,
chunks.en: He did not break its leg,
chunks.st: he would not break the animal’s leg in the typical manner of flaying an animal;

chunks.he: אֶלָּא נוֹקְבוֹ מִתּוֹךְ עַרְכּוּבּוֹ וְתוֹלֶה בוֹ.
chunks.en: rather, he made a hole through its knee and hung it by it.
chunks.st: rather, he punctures the leg from within each knee of the hind leg and suspends the animal by
chunks.stMore: placing these holes on two hooks, in order to flay the animal’s hide.

words.en: he makes a hole in it

chunks.en: He would take off the skin, going down until
chunks.st: The priest began flaying from the top of the inverted animal, descending until

chunks.en: he reaches the chest.
chunks.st: he would reach the hide of the breast.

chunks.en: When he reached the chest,
chunks.st: Once he reached the breast,

chunks.en: he cut off the head and gave it
chunks.st: he severed the lamb’s head and gave it to the priest

chunks.en: to the one who won it.
chunks.st: who won the right to take it up to the ramp.

chunks.en: He cut off the lower legs and gave them
chunks.st: Next he severed the four legs below the knee and gave them to the priest

chunks.en: to the one who won them.
chunks.st: who won the right to take them up to the ramp.

chunks.en: He finished taking off the skin.
chunks.st: He completed the flaying
chunks.stMore: of the remaining hide from the breast down, and then the priest

chunks.he: קָרַע אֶת הַלֵּב וְהוֹצִיא אֶת דָּמוֹ.
chunks.en: He cut open the heart and let out its blood.
chunks.st: cut the heart and drained its blood.

chunks.en: He cut off the front legs and gave them
chunks.st: Next the priest severed the remaining upper parts of the forelegs and gave them to the priest

chunks.en: to the one who won them.
chunks.st: who won the right to take them up to the ramp.

chunks.en: He went up to the right (back) leg,
chunks.st: Afterward he moved up to the remaining upper part of the right hind leg,

chunks.en: cut it off, and gave it to the one who won it,
chunks.st: severed it, and gave it to the priest who won the right to take it up to the ramp;

chunks.en: and two other parts went with it.
chunks.st: and the animal’s two testicles were cut along with
chunks.stMore: the right leg, leaving the animal suspended by its left hind leg.

words.note: Two parts of the animal that went with the leg.

chunks.en: He cut it open, and everything (inside) was open in front of him.
chunks.st: Then the priest tore open the animal’s midsection, resulting in the innards of the entire animal being exposed before him.

chunks.en: He took the fat and put it on
chunks.st: He took the fats and placed them

chunks.en: the place where the head was shechted, on top.
chunks.st: on the place of slaughter on the animal’s head above
chunks.stMore: it, to conceal the place where it was severed while the priest would take the head to the altar.

chunks.en: He took the insides and gave them
chunks.st: Then the priest took the innards and gave them to the priest

chunks.en: to the one who won them, to wash them.
chunks.st: who won the right to take them up to the ramp, in order to rinse them first.

chunks.en: The stomach, they wash it in the washing place,
chunks.st: And with regard to the stomach, in which there is a significant amount of waste, the priests would rinse it in the rinsing site
chunks.stMore: located in the south of the courtyard, east of the Gate of the Water,

chunks.en: and they wash it as much as it needs.
chunks.st: and they rinsed it as much it required.

chunks.he: וְהַקְּרָבַיִם מְדִיחִין אוֹתָן שְׁלשָׁה פְעָמִים בְּמִעוּטָהּ,
chunks.en: The insides, they wash them at least three times,
chunks.st: And with regard to the innards, the priests would rinse them three times at a minimum,

chunks.he: עַל שֻׁלְחָנוֹת שֶׁל שַׁיִשׁ שֶׁבֵּין הָעַמּוּדִים:
chunks.en: on the marble tables that were between the pillars.
chunks.st: on the marble tables that were positioned between the pillars in the slaughterhouse.

summary: The Kohen cut the rest of the korban into its parts. Then nine Kohanim stood in a line, each holding his parts in a special way, and brought them to the ramp. Then they went to say Shema.

chunks.en: He took the knife and separated
chunks.st: took the knife and separated

chunks.en: the lung from the liver,
chunks.st: the lung from the liver,

chunks.en: and the "finger" of the liver from the liver,
chunks.st: and the finger-like protrusion from the lower edge of the liver, also known as the lobe of the liver, from the liver.

words.note: A small piece that sticks out of the liver.

chunks.en: but he did not move it from its place.
chunks.st: And he would not move any one of the organs from its place.
chunks.stMore: He would leave the lung attached to the neck, the lobe attached to the haunch, and the liver attached to the right flank.

chunks.en: He cut around the chest and gave it
chunks.st: The priest would puncture around the breast, separating it from the flanks and the ribs, and he gave it to the priest

chunks.en: to the one who won it.
chunks.st: who won the right to take it up to the ramp.

chunks.en: He went up to the right side,
chunks.st: He then moved up to the right flank and

chunks.en: cutting and going down to the spine,
chunks.st: would cut it and separate it from the animal’s body. And he would continue to cut, descending until he would reach the spinal column,

chunks.en: but he did not touch the spine,
chunks.st: and the priest would not touch the spinal column,
chunks.stMore: leaving the spine intact and attached to the left flank.

chunks.he: עַד שֶׁהוּא מַגִּיעַ לִשְׁתֵּי צְלָעוֹת רַכּוֹת.
chunks.en: until he reached the two soft ribs.
chunks.st: He would continue cutting until he reached the space between the two narrow ribs near the neck, leaving them in place.

chunks.en: He cut it off and gave it to the one who won it,
chunks.st: The priest cut the right flank, separating it from the body of the animal, and gave it to the priest who won the right to take it up to the ramp.

chunks.en: with the liver hanging from it.
chunks.st: And the liver was suspended from it.

chunks.en: He came to the neck,
chunks.st: The priest then came to the cud.

chunks.en: and left on it two ribs
chunks.st: He left attached to it, in their entirety, the two narrow ribs

chunks.en: from this side and two ribs from that side.
chunks.st: from here, the right side, and the two narrow ribs from there, the left side.

chunks.en: He cut it off and gave it to the one who won it,
chunks.st: He cut the cud and gave it to the priest who won the right to take it up to the ramp; and

chunks.en: with the windpipe, the heart, and the lung hanging from it.
chunks.st: the windpipe, the heart, and the lung were suspended from it.

chunks.en: He came to the left side,
chunks.st: He came to cut the left flank of the body and

chunks.en: and left on it two soft ribs
chunks.st: left attached to it two narrow ribs

chunks.en: at the top and two soft ribs at the bottom.
chunks.st: above, near the haunch, as the animal was suspended upside down, and two narrow ribs below, near the cud.

chunks.en: And he did the same with the other one.
chunks.st: And he also did that with its counterpart, the right flank,

chunks.en: So he left on both of them
chunks.st: resulting in two narrow ribs in each flank

chunks.he: שְׁתַּיִם שְׁתַּיִם מִלְמַעְלָן וּשְׁתַּיִם שְׁתַּיִם מִלְּמַטָּן.
chunks.en: two ribs each at the top and two each at the bottom.
chunks.st: above and two narrow ribs in each flank below.

chunks.en: He cut it off and gave it to the one who won it,
chunks.st: He cut the left flank and gave it to the priest who won the right to take it up to the ramp,

chunks.en: with the spine,
chunks.st: and the spinal column was with it,

chunks.en: and the spleen hanging from it.
chunks.st: and the spleen was suspended from it.

chunks.en: This (left) one was really bigger,
chunks.st: And the left flank was greater,
chunks.stMore: i.e., the larger of the two, because it included the spine,

chunks.en: but they call the right one the bigger one,
chunks.st: but they referred to the right flank as the greater one,

chunks.en: because the liver hangs from it.
chunks.st: as in addition to the flank itself, the liver was suspended from it.

chunks.en: He came to the tail end,
chunks.st: He came to the haunch,

chunks.en: cut it off and gave it to the one who won it,
chunks.st: cut it, and gave it to the priest who won the right to take it up to the ramp.

chunks.he: וְהָאַלְיָה וְאֶצְבַּע הַכָּבֵד וּשְׁתֵּי כְלָיוֹת עִמּוֹ.
chunks.en: with the fat tail, the finger of the liver, and the two kidneys.
chunks.st: And the tail, and the finger-like protrusion of the liver, and the two kidneys were with it.

chunks.en: He took the left (back) leg and gave it
chunks.st: He took the remaining upper part of the left hind leg, cut it, and gave it to the priest

chunks.en: to the one who won it.
chunks.st: who won the right to take it up to the ramp.

chunks.he: נִמְצְאוּ כֻלָּן עוֹמְדִין בְּשׁוּרָה וְהָאֵבָרִים בְּיָדָם.
chunks.en: So they all stood in a line, with the parts in their hands.
chunks.st: This resulted in all of the nine priests who won the rights to take the limbs up to the ramp standing in line, and the limbs were in their hands.

chunks.en: The first one: with the head and the (right back) leg.
chunks.st: The first priest stood with the head and with the right hind leg of the animal.

chunks.en: The head in his right hand,
chunks.st: Since it was more significant, the head was in his right hand,

chunks.en: its nose toward his arm,
chunks.st: and its nose was turned toward the priest’s arm.

chunks.en: its horns between his fingers,
chunks.st: Its horns were between his fingers,

chunks.en: and the place where it was shechted on top,
chunks.st: and the place of its slaughter was above,

chunks.en: with the fat put on it.
chunks.st: and the fats were placed upon it, to conceal the bloody place of slaughter.

chunks.en: The right leg in his left hand,
chunks.st: The right hind leg was in his left hand,

chunks.en: with the skin side facing out.
chunks.st: and the outer side of the leg, from which its hide was flayed, rather than the side on which the incision was made, was facing out.

chunks.en: The second one: with the two front legs.
chunks.st: The second priest stood with the two forelegs.

chunks.en: The right one in his right hand,
chunks.st: He held the right foreleg in his right hand

chunks.en: the left one in his left hand,
chunks.st: and the left foreleg in his left hand,

chunks.en: with the skin side facing out.
chunks.st: and the outer side of the leg, from which its hide was flayed, was facing out.

chunks.en: The third one: with the tail end and the (left back) leg.
chunks.st: The third priest stood with the haunch and the left hind leg.

chunks.en: The tail end in his right hand,
chunks.st: He held the haunch in his right hand,

chunks.en: with the fat tail hanging between his fingers,
chunks.st: and the tail was hanging between his fingers,

chunks.en: and the finger of the liver and the two kidneys with it.
chunks.st: and the finger-like protrusion of the liver and the two kidneys were with it.

chunks.en: The left leg in his left hand,
chunks.st: He held the left hind leg in his left hand,

chunks.en: with the skin side facing out.
chunks.st: and the outer side of the leg, from which its hide was flayed, was facing out.

chunks.en: The fourth one: with the chest and the neck.
chunks.st: The fourth priest stood with the breast and with the cud, with

chunks.en: The chest in his right hand,
chunks.st: the breast in his right hand

chunks.en: and the neck in his left hand,
chunks.st: and the cud in his left hand,

chunks.en: with its ribs between his fingers.
chunks.st: and its two ribs were attached to the cud between his two fingers.

chunks.en: The fifth one: with the two sides.
chunks.st: The fifth priest stood with the two flanks;

chunks.en: The right one in his right hand,
chunks.st: the right flank was in his right hand

chunks.en: and the left one in his left hand,
chunks.st: and the left flank in his left hand,

chunks.en: with the skin side facing out.
chunks.st: and the outer side was facing out.

chunks.en: The sixth one: with the insides, put in a bowl, with the lower legs
chunks.st: The sixth priest stood with the innards, which were placed in a vessel, and the lower legs were placed

chunks.en: on top of them.
chunks.st: atop them from above.

chunks.en: The seventh one: with the flour.
chunks.st: The seventh priest stood with the fine flour
chunks.stMore: of the meal offering that accompanies the daily offering.

chunks.en: The eighth one: with the chavitin.
chunks.st: The eighth priest stood with the griddle-cake
chunks.stMore: offering sacrificed daily by the High Priest, half in the morning and half in the evening.

chunks.en: The ninth one: with the wine.
chunks.st: The ninth priest stood with the wine
chunks.stMore: for the libations that accompany the daily offering.

chunks.he: הָלְכוּ וּנְתָנוּם מֵחֲצִי הַכֶּבֶשׁ וּלְמַטָּה בְּמַעֲרָבוֹ,
chunks.en: They went and put them on the lower half of the ramp, on its west side,
chunks.st: The nine priests went and placed the items they were carrying on the area from halfway up the ramp and below, in the lower portion of the ramp, on the west side of the ramp,

chunks.he: וּמְלָחוּם. וְיָרְדוּ וּבָאוּ לָהֶם לְלִשְׁכַּת הַגָּזִית,
chunks.en: and salted them. Then they went down and came to the Lishkas HaGazis,
chunks.st: and they salted the limbs and the meal offering. And they descended and came to the Chamber of Hewn Stone

chunks.en: to say Shema.
chunks.st: to recite the morning Shema
chunks.stMore: and the other texts that they would recite, as explained at the beginning of the next chapter.
